dedupe_keys.name: dreal occitanie coastal flood and storm surge hazard datasets

description: DREAL Occitanie: coastal flood and storm surge hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Occitanie. Coverage: DREAL Occitanie. The listing groups 16 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about coastal flood and storm surge hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: [SHOM-IGN] trait de côte _ Histolitt®; [DREAL OCCITANIE] trait de côte 2014 _ Images satellites; [DREAL OCCITANIE] trait de côte 2019 _ Images satellites; [DREAL OCCITANIE] trait de côte 2023 _ Images satellites. Formats seen: ZIP, WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
